flow.name: stock-check-availability-for-each
flow.doc:description: Splitter with For Each: splits an order into its items and checks each item's stock in sequence, collecting the results in a variable.

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log availability request
logger.message: #['Stock availability (For Each) for orderId=' ++ (payload.orderId default 'none') ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { // After For Each the payload is the original order again. orderId: payload.orderId, splitter: "FOR_EACH", items: vars.vItemResults, allAvailable: isEmpty(vars.vItemResults filter (not $.available)), lastCheckedSku: vars.vLastCheckedSku default null }

flow.name: stock-check-availability-parallel-for-each
flow.doc:description: Splitter with Parallel For Each: splits an order into its items and checks their stock concurrently; the results come back as the list of route messages.

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log availability request
logger.message: #['Stock availability (Parallel For Each) for orderId=' ++ (payload.orderId default 'none') ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var results = payload map $.payload --- { orderId: vars.vOrderId, splitter: "PARALLEL_FOR_EACH", items: results, allAvailable: isEmpty(results filter (not $.available)), lastCheckedSku: vars.vLastCheckedSku default null }

sub-flow.name: sf-validate-order-items
sub-flow.doc:description: Validates an order sent to a splitter endpoint: orderId and a non-empty items array, each item with a sku and a numeric quantity.

when.expression: #[(not (payload is Object)) or isEmpty(payload.orderId) or (not (payload.items is Array)) or isEmpty(payload.items) or not isEmpty(payload.items filter (isEmpty($.sku) or not ($.quantity is Number)))]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Missing order items
raise-error.description: orderId and a non-empty items array (sku, quantity) are required

sub-flow.name: sf-check-item-availability
sub-flow.doc:description: Checks one order item against the synthetic stock levels; called once per item by both splitters, with the item as payload.
